properties.name: app.jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret used to sign JWT access tokens.

properties.name: app.jwt.expiration-ms
properties.description: JWT access token lifetime in milliseconds.

properties.name: app.jwt.refresh-expiration-ms
properties.description: JWT refresh token lifetime in milliseconds.

properties.name: app.google-safe-browsing.base-url
properties.description: Google Safe Browsing API base URL.

properties.name: app.rdap.base-url
properties.description: RDAP bootstrap base URL used to look up domain registration dates.

properties.name: app.content-analysis.enabled
properties.description: Enables fetching and scraping the analyzed page with Jsoup.

properties.name: app.content-analysis.timeout-ms
properties.description: Connect/response timeout for page fetching in milliseconds.

properties.name: app.content-analysis.max-bytes
properties.description: Maximum number of bytes downloaded per page.

properties.name: app.content-analysis.max-redirects
properties.description: Maximum number of redirects followed when fetching a page.

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.requests-per-minute
properties.description: Maximum requests per minute for rate-limited endpoints.
